outcome: Help admissions teams process complete applications faster while preserving fair, accountable decisions.
overview: Applicants and admissions teams navigate fragmented forms, documents, communications and equivalency checks, so complete applications still wait weeks for a decision. This solution captures and classifies documents, checks completeness, extracts evidence, answers applicant questions with citations and routes exceptions to the right officer. Eligibility and admission decisions always remain with authorised staff under published policy, with reason codes, retention rules and an appeal path. A one-intake pilot targets a 30% reduction in the median time from complete application to human decision, alongside fewer incomplete submissions and better applicant visibility, with outcomes monitored for unfair differences across applicant groups.

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (UAE, KSA); applicant documents and data stay in the institution’s tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: The institution wants automated admission or rejection decisions
notFor.why: The design keeps eligibility and admission decisions with authorised staff under published policy — automation stops at preparation and routing

notFor.situation: No documented admission criteria or digital application process
notFor.why: Completeness checks and evidence extraction need published criteria and digital inputs to work against

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the institution owns admission policy, decisions and applicant communications · Duration: 8–12 weeks pilot; 16–24 weeks to production
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, document-processing engineer, integration engineer; customer admissions director, registrar, privacy officer, service-desk lead · Support model: Business-hours support with peak-intake extended cover; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Journey design and criteria mapping
2) Document benchmark and extraction build
3) Case workflow and integration build
4) Accessibility and security testing
5) Pilot intake operation
6) Reconciliation and benefit review
deliverables: Extraction and completeness targets met on the document benchmark
Human decision and appeal path proven for every application
Secure deletion and retention rules proven
SIS/CRM reconciliation clean at intake close; staff UAT complete
languages: English delivery; Arabic and English applicant journeys supported
